sources.citation: Henri Tajfel, M. G. Billig, R. P. Bundy, Claude Flament (1971). Social categorization and intergroup behaviour. European Journal of Social Psychology.
sources.notes: Foundational primary study (1971) in European Journal of Social Psychology establishing the core experimental paradigm and quantitative parameters.

sources.citation: Michael Billig, Henri Tajfel (1973). Social categorization and similarity in intergroup behaviour. European Journal of Social Psychology.
sources.notes: Demonstrates significant ingroup favoritism even when group categorization is explicitly made by visible random coin toss.

sources.citation: Marilynn B. Brewer (1999). The Psychology of Prejudice: Ingroup Love and Outgroup Hate? Journal of Social Issues.
sources.notes: Clarifies that minimal-group discrimination primarily reflects preferential ingroup reward allocation ('ingroup love') rather than active outgroup hostility.

sources.citation: Sabine Otten (2011). Minimal Group Paradigm. The Encyclopedia of Peace Psychology.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2011) in The Encyclopedia of Peace Psychology extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Michael Diehl (1990). The Minimal Group Paradigm: Theoretical Explanations and Empirical Findings. European Review of Social Psychology.
sources.notes: Comprehensive review of minimal-group ingroup favoritism experiments and social-identity vs interdependence mechanisms.
